reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-08-29. Transfero's current BRZ page, published 2026-08-28, still states 1:1 BRL backing and links the same Reserve report PDF; the page shows R$15.2MM collateral and R$12.3MM circulating but gives no report date beyond the linked artifact. The reachable report is dated March 31, 2024 at 18:00 BRT, reports R$15,243,944.24 collateral against R$12,398,003.00 circulating, and says the reserve is held at an institution authorized by the Central Bank of Brazil without naming it. No newer composition or independent reconciliation was found. The one 100% BRL bank-deposit slice remains a historical disclosure and is outside the 31-day plus seven-day static-composition window; no current reserve claim is asserted.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Transfero BRZ transparency report dated March 31, 2024 (re-hosted URL from live product page)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer discloses a single authorized-institution BRL reserve category but not the institution name, account terms, liquidity terms, segregation, or a report more recent than March 31, 2024.
